windows.calendar_precision: Preserve source year/month/day precision. Qualify a window only when the entire supported interval is inside it. Do not replace a month/year by an arbitrary day or treat the AACT parsed date as more precise than the raw field.
windows.timezone: UTC cutoffs; preserve exact source timezone if stated; unknown boundary timezone/precision remains held.

extraction_contract.selected_trials: Exactly the fixed twelve at both January1,2026 and April1,2026. Missing/held records remain represented, never replaced.
extraction_contract.tables: Version-qualified study metadata and reported outcomes, groups, analyses, analysis-group links, counts and measurements; retain document pointers, exact source rows, nulls and QC dispositions.
extraction_contract.versions: Qualify the actual record version using posted availability/type, source release and receipts. A current/snapshot date alone does not establish a particular row's public availability.
extraction_contract.diagnostic: Compare repeated read-only query results; preserve unsuccessful/held tables and missingness. No outcome presence or source accessibility can change sample membership.
extraction_contract.limitations: Selected-trial follow-up cannot by itself establish complete same-program higher-phase history or complete first-event negatives. No additional program-wide registry search is authorized implicitly by this fixed metadata extraction.

required_evidence_per_endpoint: Frozen NCT/program/regimen/arm/population/objective identity with scope mapping evidence and contradictions.
Endpoint-local origin risk disposition: qualified, already occurred, not applicable or unknown; evidence and remaining caveats. No blanket prior-higher-phase exclusion for selected-trial efficacy.
Authentic prospective decision-rule version and evidence that it preceded the designated analysis/unblinding, where efficacy polarity is adjudicated.
Source-linked designated analysis, result, comparator, analysis population, intercurrent/missingness rules, multiplicity and interim/final status where relevant.
Distinct clinical observation, analysis/decision and disclosure intervals, with uncertainty and contradictions explicitly recorded.
Verified evaluator-source availability at or before ascertainment, exact bytes/hash/locator and reuse restrictions.
Qualification decision with all unmet conditions preserved; unknown is not a negative.

efficacy_decision.unit: The selected trial's prespecified primary efficacy objective, analysis, experimental regimen and population; retain a mapping to the frozen program and each scope hold.
efficacy_decision.positive: 1 only for a qualified in-window definitive decision satisfying the authentic prospectively specified primary trial-level efficacy criterion and every required risk/scope/time/source condition.
efficacy_decision.negative: 0 only for an explicit qualified in-window definitive failure of the same primary criterion at its designated analysis. Full-horizon observation is unnecessary for that fixed failed decision. A nonbinding/interim futility crossing or continuation decision cannot be treated as final failure/success without the prospectively specified definitive stopping rule and documented implementation.
efficacy_decision.null: Missing rule/result/analysis date, unqualified origin risk or scope, primary safety-only, descriptive physiology, pending final analysis, patient response without a trial-level rule, isolated nominal/secondary significance, inaccessible or temporally unqualified evidence remains null.
efficacy_decision.multiple_primary: Retain co-primary or hierarchical structure. Do not choose the most favorable objective, ignore multiplicity, promote a secondary endpoint, or pool arms. If source documents reveal an authentic objective amendment, preserve both versions and explain applicability before applying any rule.
efficacy_decision.rule_reconstruction: Partial planning assumptions, power/alpha alone, a measurement scale, participant response definition, dosing rule or stage1 continuation threshold does not complete an absent final success rule. No guessed p-value threshold or calculated posthoc decision rule.
efficacy_decision.scope_conflict: Report observed results in their actual source scope. Until a documented bridge resolves a frozen regimen/population contradiction, do not transfer a trial/other-cohort success label to the frozen program. A separate source-scope diagnostic may be described with an explicit non-transferability flag.

higher_phase_registry_start.positive: 1 only for a qualified first same-program higher-phase ACTUAL registry start interval in-window, with qualified at-origin absence of any earlier same-program qualifying start within an explicitly adequate source frame.
higher_phase_registry_start.negative: 0 only with endpoint-local risk qualification and explicit complete same-program horizon ascertainment; no returned record or selected-trial status alone is insufficient.
higher_phase_registry_start.null: Unresolved aliases, program/regimen/population identity, prior-risk/source completeness, estimated/overlapping date intervals or unavailable same-program frame remain null.
higher_phase_registry_start.separation: Registry enrollment/start is distinct from actual selected-arm dosing, clinical efficacy and regulatory approval.

selected_arm_first_dose.positive: 1 only for direct qualified evidence of this specified arm's first experimental dosing in-window and qualified not-already-dosed status at origin; never infer from overall enrollment/start.
selected_arm_first_dose.negative: 0 only with qualified complete selected-arm horizon ascertainment and endpoint-local origin risk. Missing dose disclosure, completion or commercial discontinuation alone is insufficient.
selected_arm_first_dose.null: First-ever global drug use, parent-trial exposure, randomized continuation dosing or nonspecific trial enrollment cannot resolve the selected-arm event without a direct regimen/arm bridge.

decision_occurrence_diagnostic.one: Qualified selected-trial definitive efficacy success OR failure decision in-window, with all occurrence/risk/scope/source conditions met; polarity separately retained.
decision_occurrence_diagnostic.zero: Explicit source-qualified complete absence of such a decision through horizon among an endpoint-local qualified risk set; no-record alone is insufficient and this value is not H1 efficacy failure.
decision_occurrence_diagnostic.null: All other unqualified, censored, competing, undefined or temporally uncertain states.
decision_occurrence_diagnostic.separate_disclosure: A disclosure within the window about a pre-origin, post-horizon or unknown-date analysis is only a disclosure diagnostic, not an in-window decision.

bounded_primary_source_recovery.start_condition: Only after the pack and this adjudication contract are sealed and fixed follow-up extraction is complete; never to select replacements.
bounded_primary_source_recovery.definition: One original primary artifact/version with its supplement package counts as a document; each substantively distinct version or correction also counts. Do not evade caps by combining several primary artifacts into one file. Shared artifacts are logged against every trial they inform and once as a unique artifact in the total.
order: Versioned authentic trial protocol/SAP or registry-linked authentic protocol/SAP for scope and prespecification
Primary trial report or original conference report with methods/results and exact selected scope
Original investigator/sponsor/regulatory decision disclosure or authentic correction needed to resolve dates/scope
bounded_primary_source_recovery.search_budget: At most three targeted search queries per fixed NCT (NCT plus protocol/SAP; NCT plus primary results; NCT plus decision/date). Screen official/primary snippets and pointers without treating snippets as qualified scientific evidence. Stop each trial at three retained primary artifacts, including retained rejected temporal versions, or the global cap.
bounded_primary_source_recovery.retrieval_log: Record every query, URL, attempt, access error and screened/rejected source. Each retrieved original must have retrieval time, source identity, content hash, version/date evidence and accepted/held/rejected status. Raw-source reuse terms apply.
bounded_primary_source_recovery.availability: Exact public version must be demonstrably available by April1,2026. Source content can describe an earlier event without proving when the public version existed. Current download time, PDF internal metadata alone, undated website content, retrospective assertion or journal article publication date detached from the downloaded version is insufficient.
bounded_primary_source_recovery.future: Explicitly later information cannot adjudicate this window. Log as excluded/context-only with no label contribution; do not repair an earlier unqualified source using a future correction silently.
bounded_primary_source_recovery.prespecification: A protocol/SAP made public after origin can be evaluator-only if authentic version and timing show prespecification before analysis/unblinding and public availability by ascertainment. Uncertain timing remains held; later public does not mean retrospectively specified, nor does an early-looking version date establish authenticity by itself.
bounded_primary_source_recovery.unavailable: At cap, inaccessible, paywalled, unavailable, unknown-time or contradictory documents remain explicit missing/held evidence. No paid access, credentials, outreach or unbounded citation snowballing.

required_output_per_trial: Three endpoint records, including not-applicable/unknown states, with null or supported binary label
Origin risk, objective, regimen/population, prospective-rule, timing, source and completeness qualification components
Source-linked observed facts even when clinical label unqualified
Explicit holds, contradictions, unavailable inputs, future-source exclusions and reason codes
Independent reviewer agreement/disagreement and final retained resolution

feasibility_summary.fixed_denominators: Twelve frozen members per endpoint,36 endpoint records; show safety/undefined/held/not-at-risk separately without dropping them from all-member yield.
feasibility_summary.primary_measure: Source-qualified labels or decisions observed divided by all12 frozen members for each endpoint, with numerator definition explicit; scientific risk qualification shown separately from mere reported-outcome presence.
feasibility_summary.precision: Report realized numerator/denominator and yield, plus identified target/drug/regimen/sponsor dependence clusters and unresolved overlap. This fixed maturity-selected exposed sample has no justified independent Bernoulli sampling model or population target, so compute no calibrated population confidence interval or power from it. Do not present an IID Wilson reference as an empirical confidence interval; default is no interval calculation.
feasibility_summary.conditional_polarity: Successes/(qualified successes+failures) only when nonzero, with excluded unknowns and n shown; this is an ascertainment-conditioned descriptive fraction, not cohort success probability, training prevalence or predictive performance.
feasibility_summary.power: No credible classifier power or train/calibrate activation from twelve exposed members. Report effective qualified risk-set size, event/nonevent counts and missingness; larger-study power awaits defensible prevalence, correlation and effect assumptions.
feasibility_summary.yield_failure: Zero qualified labels is a valid feasibility outcome, not permission to relax rules or relabel missing as failed.

review_limits: AI-assisted scientific review and independent technical/source checks are not independent biological truth or domain-scientist validation. Require explicit disclosure; no live-model evaluation, clinical deployment or scientific-validation claim.
publication_gate: New-phase joined context requires exact shared metadata/results version fields; populated results need ACTUAL qualified first posting by source snapshot and ascertainment, else held. Missing or empty tables never supply a negative.
